author: blu
body: Portable bitmap font for foreword-level rendering. Glyphs indexed by CCE code, not ASCII. The kernel has BitmapFont.codex (8x16, alloc-bytes, O(1) lookup) for bare-metal rendering; this chapter provides a List-based 5x7 font for foreword tests and tools. Covers CCE 0-96 (whitespace, digits, letters, punctuation).
